messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — drafting release notes and internal announce for tomorrow's rollout. Change window 2026-03-21 00:00-02:00 UTC. Canary -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Pinning candidate: `redwood-model-service@v1.8.2-rc3`. Need: release one-liner, brief rollback criteria, who owns standby + ops channel monitor.

jamie: One-liner suggestion: "Reduce inference tail latency by 18%; default model runtime improvements and better batching." Thoughts?

sasha: LGTM. For notes add: "No API surface changes; backward-compatible routing." Also: add guide for forced pin fallback: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/pin --data '{"service":"model-service","version":"v1.8.1"}'`

sasha: Snippet:
```
Rollback quick command:
./scripts/rollback.sh --service model-service --to v1.8.1
```

maria: Ops: I'll be standby for the first hour. Ops-oncall will take 02:00-04:00 UTC. @ops-oncall can you confirm dashboard alerts/alerting thresholds?

ops-oncall: Confirmed. I updated Alert:ModelServingLatency to 95th=800ms. Pager rules enabled. I'll keep watchers on error rate>1% sustained 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex: canary rollout for `redwood-model-service` to `us-west-2` at 2026-03-21T00:05Z. Steps: canary(5m) -> ramp(25m). Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/model-rollout

alex: Also adding "fallback lane" — if model error rate>1% or latency>1s then auto-roll to `v1.8.1` and notify #eng-oncall. Maria, confirm automatic fallback ok?

maria: Auto-fallback enabled in deploy config. We'll trigger and verify. Please ensure RN mentions "automatic fallback to v1.8.1 if regressions".

jamie: Draft RN snippet for internal ANN:
```
- Release: model-service v1.8.2-rc3 (pinned)
- Impact: gen latency -18% p95, no API changes
- Rollout: Canary 03/21 00:05 UTC -> full by 00:35 UTC
- Rollback: auto fallback to v1.8.1 on error rate >1% or p95>1000ms
- Owners: Maria (ops standby), Alex (release lead), ops-oncall (monitor)
```

sasha: Add note: "Deduped KV cache warm-up may cause brief CPU spike on canary hosts; expected <3min." Suggest CPU alarm at 80% for 1m.

maria: Ack. I'll update runbook CPU threshold.

alex: Ok moving to finalize. @deploy-bot please set pin `redwood-model-service@v1.8.2-rc3` in release metadata and create internal announce draft in #eng-releases for 15m before start.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: `redwood-model-service@v1.8.2-rc3`. Created internal announce draft: https://intranet.redwood/notes/3777012345-rn-dryrun (editable). Scheduled reminder 15m before rollout.

jamie: Thanks — I'll copy edit RN and post the internal announcement 15m prior. :thumbsup: 

ops-oncall: I'll join the standby channel at rollout start. Good to go from my side.
